constraints.checkpoint_identity: Mandatory current checkpoint/model/report hashes. Record actual target_kl, clip range, nominal epoch counter and per-parameter Adam steps separately at initial/selected/final. Frozen settings/actions/state must restore exactly.

activation_gate.screen: Candidate actual final Adam steps must be positive and strictly below the unchanged control maximum; otherwise record nonactivation and do not promote. No extending/tuning to force activation.
